items.title: Capture M0 profiling baseline and runtime hot-path cost
items.context: Record current full 1M baseline and representative runtime pack timings as non-authoritative benchmark evidence. This must remain report-only and must not make memory gate evidence.

items.title: Add M1 derived runtime memory index with atomic rebuild semantics
items.context: Define a disposable local index rebuilt from dev-memory/playbook source files. Rebuild must write temp, validate manifest/digest, then atomically swap indexVersion so readers never observe partial indexes.

items.title: Implement M2 indexed two-stage retrieval with small fixture parity
items.context: Runtime pack generation should retrieve indexed candidates, rank only bounded candidates, and match existing full-scan behavior on active/candidate/superseded/stale/deprecated/malformed small fixtures. Preserve gateEvidence=false and non-authoritative output.
